info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Drivers-v5-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Driver List API provides access to information about drivers associated with food delivery services. This endpoint allows users to retrieve details about active drivers, including their availability and performance metrics. Typical consumers of this API include food delivery platforms, logistics applications, and management systems seeking to optimize driver assignment and scheduling. By using this API, businesses can enhance operational efficiency and improve customer service through better resource allocation.

get.summary: Retrieve deliveries assigned to a specific driver.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all deliveries that are currently assigned to the specified driver. You can use this information to track the driver's assignments and manage delivery operations efficiently.

requestBody.description: The request body must contain parameters related to the driver for delivery operations. Specify the necessary details to retrieve the delivery information associated with a particular driver.

200.description: Successful retrieval of driver delivery information.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesDriversRequest.description: This schema represents the request body expected for the GET operation on the driver deliveries endpoint.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for tracking the delivery.

resultId.description: An identifier for the operation result.

state.description: The current state of the delivery operation.
